title: Traffic Slice Forensics: Runbook for route-level rollout observability & auto-rollback signatures
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Summary:
Provide a focused runbook and UX/telemetry spec for route-level rollout forensics in Console. This ticket scopes a set of console features and backend telemetry changes that let PMs, SREs, and engineers quickly detect, diagnose, and act on regressions during canaries, A/B tests and shadow traffic runs — with deterministic auto-rollback signatures.

Problem:
Currently console shows per-route metrics and traces but lacks a structured forensics workflow for split traffic: operators waste time hunting traces, reconstructing cohorts, and testing hypotheses. There is no canonical set of 'rollback signatures' that tie metric deltas + trace anomalies to an automated rollback policy.

Proposal (high level):
- Add a "Traffic Slice Forensics" panel in the Route/Deployment page that: (1) surfaces side-by-side metric diffs for arbitrary slices (by region, model variant, API key); (2) links to a correlated trace timeline; (3) provides ranked hypothesis cards (latency spike, token error rate, semantic drift).
- Define a minimal telemetry schema required for forensics: per-request route_id, variant_id, cohort_id, split_percentage, trace_id, model_version, kv_cache_hit, tokens_generated, latency_p50/p95, token_error_flag, output_quality_score (if available).
- Implement deterministic rollback signatures composed of a weighted rule-set: (metric delta thresholds, trace-error prevalence, quality-regression > X) that can be attached to a rollout policy and evaluated in real time.
- UX: diff view with waterfall of metric deltas, a trace-link button that opens trace with pre-applied filters, and an explain panel that lists top 3 likely root causes with confidence scores.

Acceptance criteria:
- Backend emits the telemetry schema for 95% of requests for 2 alpha customers in Dedicated and Hosted modes (logged to telemetry topic).
- Console shows side-by-side diffs for up to 10 slices; UI has trace-link that opens trace explorer with cohort filters pre-applied.
- One auto-rollback signature implemented and hooked into existing rollout engine; test scenario demonstrates automatic rollback on a simulated quality regression (test harness + synthetic traffic).
- Documentation and runbook (Confluence) published with remediation steps, SRE checklist, and example queries for 3 standard incidents.

Telemetry & Data Retention:
- Store aggregated deltas per slice at 1m granularity for 30d, traces retained per existing tracing retention. Provide sample SQL/flux queries for rapid triage.

Open questions / trade-offs:
- How to compute output_quality_score deterministically across models? (ML team to propose proxy metrics: token-level perplexity on control prompts, rerank score deltas).
- Cost vs retention: propose progressive retention where full request-level data kept for 7d and aggregates for 30d.

Rollout plan:
1) API contract + telemetry schema finalized (this ticket).
2) Backend event emission (ENG) + test harness (integration).
3) Console UI (iterative): initial diff table -> trace-link -> explain cards.
4) Auto-rollback rule wired to rollout engine and validated in staging.

Deliverables:
- Telemetry schema and example events (Confluence link).
- Console panel mockups (Figma link) and acceptance tests.
- Integration test that triggers rollback signature in staging.
- Runbook covering manual and automated remediation steps.
